content:
The [Random Name Picker](/random-name-picker) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Choose a random name for classrooms, giveaways and team selections. Enter your one name per line and seed (deterministic — for games/demos only) and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Choose a random name for classrooms, giveaways and team selections. This free online random name picker gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Random Name Picker

Start by typing or pasting your one name per line, then entering your seed (deterministic — for games/demos only). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Type or paste your one name per line.
2. Enter your seed (deterministic — for games/demos only).
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

A uniformly distributed random index selects one non-empty line. Change the seed for another draw.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Random Name Picker](/random-name-picker) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Check the units and labels before comparing results.
- Your entries stay in your browser and are not saved.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is this random name picker free?

Yes. It is free to use, with no sign-up or installation required. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [Random Name Picker](/random-name-picker) and start straight away.

### Are my entries stored?

No. Calculations run in your browser and the tool does not save your entries. You can use it as often as you like, and because nothing is uploaded, stored or tracked, there is nothing to delete afterwards.

### What formula does the Random Name Picker use?

A uniformly distributed random index selects one non-empty line. Change the seed for another draw. You can see it in action in the [Random Name Picker](/random-name-picker) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the Random Name Picker?

Just One name per line and Seed (deterministic — for games/demos only). Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.
